component.name: Uranium
component.summary: Chromium without Google, which becomes Chrome for Android on a phone

description.p: Uranium is ungoogled-chromium with an ad blocker, no requests to Google or anyone else the user did not ask for, and V8's optimizing compilers off until a site needs them. On a screen under 600 pixels on its short side it uses the touch layout and Chrome for Android's power saving, and introduces itself to sites as Chrome for Android.
